notes: DRAFT mix for the 22-hour A100 session (31 Oct 10:00 -> 1 Nov 08:00), v2 (31 Oct, after Namit's and Prabanjan's new bins). Used by scripts/gpu_session.py via --config: only 'name' and 'weight' matter there; a domain whose <name>.train.bin is not in --bins is left out and the rest are renormalised. File names must be exactly <name>.train.bin / <name>.val.bin. Weights are shares of training tokens, chosen so that for a ~3B-token run no verified domain is seen more than about 1.3 times (available train tokens in millions: math 996, physics 637, gen_eng 586, exp_val 629, tech_comm 534, engineering (Ravi, agent trajectories) 814, eng_reasoning (Prabanjan, pending rebuild) ~700, code 323, sciqa 189, chem 128, cad 78, sciprog 50, bio 45, earth 73, scidisc 1002, multistep 88, astro 20, finance 17). cad is low because it is templated; multistep and finance because they are generated records. Domains 9 and 10 (Swaraj) are NOT in the mix: the 20 MB samples are mostly unrelated general text with about half the documents duplicated. Pankaj decides the final weights.
